findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise and violates CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark guidance on key rotation.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the account root full control, which allows any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer the key. An explicit least-privilege key policy should scope encrypt/decrypt usage to the log bucket and specific principals.
